CustomField.description: The person's date of birth. Used in place of the standard Birthdate field because Shield Platform Encryption can't encrypt the standard field; this one is encrypted (probabilistic) once Shield is turned on. Never filter, sort or search on it: flows read it after finding the person another way. Licenses that expire on the holder's birthday and the age checks read it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The person's date of birth. Licenses that expire on the birthday use it.
CustomField.label: Date of Birth
